# Background

In the [previous]() walk-through, we generated signature matrices for both bead and cell controls using the `flowGate` and `Luciernaga` R packages. The normalized fluorescent signatures were generated by extracting cells (or beads) from the peak detector gates, taking the median measurement across these, subtracting out the equivalent background, and then normalizing (scaling) the values to range from 0 to 1. This resulted in the following signature matrices. 

This above workflow is similar to that of many commercial software. However, a lot more information can be gleaned from our unmixing controls, and in this walk-through we will explore how to leverage some of this information to be able to ascertain whether we should replace any of our unmixing controls due to any myriad of issues that they can experience. 


# Walk Through

As always, we begin by attaching the packages we will need today to our local environment via the `library()` call. 

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(flowWorkspace)
library(Luciernaga)
```

With this done, lets re-specify the file paths to our Storage and Output locations. 

```{r}
#StorageLocation <- file.path("course", "SDY3080", "data", "SDY3080")
StorageLocation <- file.path("data", "SDY3080")

#OutputLocation <- file.path("course", "SDY3080", "outputs")
OutputLocation <- file.path("outputs")
```

And then, lets load in our CellSC GatingSet that contained all the validated peak detector gates. 

```{r}
CellSCPath <- file.path(OutputLocation, "CellsSC_GS_Amplified.gs")
CellsSC_GatingSet <- load_gs(CellSCPath)
```

```{r}
#| eval: FALSE
plot(CellsSC_GatingSet)
```

![](images/71_CellGates.png)

And finally, to keep in style of the previous workflows, lets assemble part of the template. 

```{r}
Template <- pData(CellsSC_GatingSet)
Template <- Template |> relocate(Fluorophore, Antigen, Type, Detector, Negative, .after="name")

KeptCells <- Template |>
     filter(!name %in% "DTR_2023_ILT_01-Reference Group-DR_Dump_CD19 Pacific Blue (Cells).1235702.fcs") |>
     filter(!name %in% "DTR_2023_ILT_01-Reference Group-DR_Viability_PMA Zombie NIR (Cells).1235709.fcs") |>
     filter(!name %in% "DTR_2023_ILT_01-Reference Group-DR_CD3 Alexa Fluor 488 (Cells).1235688.fcs") 

# View(KeptCells)
# plot(CellsSC_GatingSet)
```

## Detailed Example

Lets start with one of the more illustrative examples from this experimental GatingSet, the cell APC-Fire 810 unmixing control. The reasons why will become obvious shortly. 

```{r}
APCFire810 <- LuciernagaIntegration(template=KeptCells[14,], gs=CellsSC_GatingSet, GuessSimilar=TRUE)

APCFire810$LuciernagaQC_Signatures

APCFire810$LuciernagaQC_AmalgamatedPlot

APCFire810$GuessSimilar_Plot

APCFire810$ProportionPlot

APCFire810$CosineSimilarityPlot

APCFire810$LinearSlices_Plot
```

## Unstained Controls

```{r}
Unstained_GatingSet <- load_gs("outputs/CellsUnstained_GS_Amplified.gs")

Updated <- pData(Unstained_GatingSet) |>  mutate(Type="Cells", Fluorophore="scatter",
 Antigen="Autofluorescence", Detector="V7", Negative="NoSubtraction")
```
